name: task_000

input.prompt: You are given 50 mL of an unknown sample solution containing differnet inorganic cations. Your task is to perform experiments using the sample and the given reagents, and use the observations to deduce which cations are present in the solution. Most experiments will consume a portion of the sample. If you run out of the sample, you cannot perform any more experiments and you must submit your answer.

submission_format: Comma-separated string of the cations present. Examples: 'K+, Cd2+, Al3+' or 'Li+, Fe3+, Al3+, Ca2+, Cu2+'
